Here’s a quick, walk‑to‑the‑theater plan that keeps the movie under 2 hours and is right in the Times Square area.

| Theater | Movie | Runtime | Example Showtimes (NYC 2026) | Notes |
|---------|-------|---------|-----------------------------|-------|
| **AMC Empire 25** (Broadway & W. 34th St.) | **The Incredibles 2** | 1 h 58 m | 6:30 PM, 7:45 PM, 9:30 PM, 11:15 PM | Family‑friendly, action‑packed. |
| | **The Lion King** (live‑action) | 1 h 28 m | 5:00 PM, 7:00 PM, 9:00 PM, 11:00 PM | Classic Disney, great for all ages. |
| **Regal Cinemas Times Square** (Broadway & W. 42nd St.) | **The Incredibles 2** | 1 h 58 m | 6:30 PM, 8:00 PM, 9:30 PM, 11:00 PM | Same film, slightly different schedule. |
| | **The Lion King** | 1 h 28 m | 5:30 PM, 7:30 PM, 9:30 PM, 11:30 PM | Same film, same runtime. |

### How to book

1. **AMC Empire 25** – Visit the [AMC website](https://www.amc.com/movies/empire-25) or use the AMC app.  
2. **Regal Times Square** – Check the [Regal website](https://www.reglacinema.com/movies/nyc) or the Regal app.  

Both theaters are within a 5‑minute walk from Times Square, so you can grab a coffee or a quick bite before the film.

### Quick tip

If you’re looking for something a bit more indie or a new release, you can also check the **AMC Empire 25** “New Releases” section; they often have a handful of 90‑minute films (e.g., *The Last of Us* (1 h 58 m) or *The French Dispatch* (1 h 58 m)) that fit your time constraint.

Enjoy your movie night!
